items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one clean standalone 2D fighting-game arena background for Infernal Versus, Hazbin Hotel / Helluva Boss fan game. Produce ONE landscape image, NOT a sprite sheet or collage. Wide 16:9 composition, side-on 2D fighting-stage camera at character chest height, horizontal playable floor crossing the entire lower quarter with its standing baseline near 80 percent of the image height. Clear low-detail center and readable fighter silhouettes. High quality 2D cartoon television background painting, crisp tapered dark linework, flat colors and restrained cel shading, not a 3D render and not pixel art. The attached isolated props are STYLE AND PALETTE REFERENCES ONLY; their sprites will be rendered separately in the game, so do not paste or recreate them in the foreground. Background must be an opaque complete scene. No people, no character silhouettes, no HUD, no title card, no watermarks, no written captions. This is a staged game adaptation of the setting, not a documentary or claimed exact frame reconstruction. Scene: the rural ranch atmosphere of Helluva Boss's Wrath Ring, an empty dusty farmyard at burnt-orange dusk. Place a weathered timber barn toward the far right behind the fighting lane, low rail fences and distant crimson mesas, strange sparse thorn scrub and muted amber sky. Distinct distant sky/mesas, midground farm buildings and continuous near dirt ground. The main fighting lane is level, broad and unobstructed across the full width, no deep trench or steps. Match the warm ochre straw, burgundy outlines and western carnival styling of the reference props, but leave the hay bale and hanging pennant as separate objects for later compositing. No animals or figures. No lettering.

prompts.angeldust_ready: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: ONE individual transparent full-body 2D fighting-game sprite, Angel Dust from Hazbin Hotel, his season-one pink suit appearance. Input image is the project's existing character reference: retain his recognisable very tall extremely slender spider-demon silhouette, fluffy white swept-up hair, asymmetric pink eye markings, wide sly grin, tiny black bow tie, pale pink-and-white striped tailored coat with pointed tails, black shorts and thigh-high black heeled boots. Draw EXACTLY FOUR arms with readable separate hands (two upper arms and two lower arms), two legs. Pose: ready fighting guard, full body in side-three-quarter view FACING RIGHT, staggered feet on one horizontal baseline, upper hands raised in loose guarded fists and lower hands open below his waist. No gun for this acrobatic ready pose. Composition: portrait canvas 1024 by 1536, body head-to-toe at about 84 percent of canvas height, centered at x=512, feet baseline y=1400. Keep minimum 8 percent clear transparent margins; all hair tips, hands, coattails, and heels fully visible. High-quality clean flat cel animation matching Hazbin Hotel line shapes and reference palette, crisp black outlines, minimal cel shadows, no painterly texture. Deliver ONLY one character on real fully transparent RGBA background. No floor, no oval shadow, no text, no labels, no sheet, no inset, no second character. This is a gameplay adaptation pose; preserve all identity details from reference.

items.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one complete wide side-view background layer for the Infernal Versus 2D fighting game, Carmine Industries armory, Hazbin Hotel. Reference image 1 is the existing in-game industrial hall; use its gothic factory silhouette, red/black/silver palette and straight horizontal fighting platform as composition reference. Redraw the hall as a premium hand-drawn animated-series background with clean precise dark outlines, angular graphic architecture and controlled cel-shading, consistent with Hazbin Hotel. A spacious Carmilla-style weapons warehouse/armory, rows of silver angelic weapons behind tall glass cases in the far background, iron catwalks, hanging factory trusses, cool pale window light, small muted red furnace glows. Camera is side-on at fighter chest height, almost orthographic, broad central space completely free for two tall fighters. Flat horizontal combat floor across the entire bottom quarter, straight horizon, no vanishing point through the combat plane, no obstacles in center, do not place props in the foreground (those are separate layers). This is an original playable stage adaptation of the existing reference, not an episode screenshot. Output a single finished background, no panels or contact sheet.
